source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.4, printed pages 308-309.

blocks.text: Hydrocarbons qudrati taur par nabatat, jangal ki aag, aatish-fishan aur rasao (seeps) se, aur insani sargarmiyon jaise fossil fuels ke na-mukammal jalne, oil ke girne aur sanati aur gariyon ke ikhraj se paida hote hain; gariyan bara zariya hain. Methane sab se aam hydrocarbon air pollutant hai.

blocks.prompt: Hawa mein hydrocarbons ke bunyadi qudrati aur insani zaraye, aur sab se aam hydrocarbon pollutant batayein.
blocks.explanation: Qudrati: nabatat, jangal ki aag, aatish-fishan aur oil aur gas ka qudrati rasao. Insani: fossil fuels ka na-mukammal jalna, oil ka girna, sanati aur sab se barh kar gariyon ka ikhraj. Methane sab se aam hai.

items: Hydrocarbons nabatat, jangal ki aag, aatish-fishan, rasao se; na-mukammal jalna, oil ka girna, sanat, gariyan (bara); methane sab se aam.
